always_short_straddle: the backtest engine's delta-hedged 30-day ATM straddle held short every session at 0.10 size: the mark-to-model premium factor
excess_returns: index return over the backtest's own session intervals minus the T-bill accrual of the backtest's cash benchmark (nav_tbill)

fields.alpha_ann / alpha_t: intercept × 252 (excess return per year) and its Newey-West t
fields.beta: OLS slope of sleeve on benchmark daily excess returns
fields.corr_daily: Pearson correlation of daily excess returns
fields.partial_corr_ex_spx: correlation after a linear regression of both on the SPX daily return (removes linear delta, not gamma)
fields.sharpe_diff: sleeve Sharpe minus benchmark Sharpe (annualised, rf = 0 on excess returns)

implied_beta.method: cash-secured put-write replication with puts at σ = β·VIX-TS(T): strike = SPX close on the roll date, sold at that close; monthly puts settle at Cboe's SET value (Yahoo open where SET has no row), weekly puts at the close; collateral earns ^IRX. β solves replication return = index return per period, per expiry year and overall. The indices sell at a VWAP and PUT's collateral earns 1- and 3-month bills, so this is an approximation; 2025 covers January-March only.
